scope: Standing square crest-mounted Upper Reservoir Valve House, with granite walls, flat corbelled roof and two blocked rear openings.
geometryBasis: Approximate 4.12 m square valve house inside the original upstream platform projection of mapped dam way 448005771, one third of the way along the mapped crest.
sectionBasis: Rock-faced granite walls, one path-side door, two stone-blocked rear windows, and a flat overhanging roof on corbels. Shared dam ground reference aligns the valve house at the crest elevation.
limitations: The supporting dam and its small upstream platform are mapped. The valve-house square, height, orientation of openings and masonry detailing are estimates from written descriptions.
The choice of position on the platform and ground connection use the same crest-height reference as the separate Upper Reservoir Dam model.

facts.position: about one third along the top of the dam
